service-page.question: What is your typical turnaround time?
service-page.answer: Timeline varies by project complexity. Simple projects may take 2-3 weeks, while comprehensive campaigns can take 2-3 months. We provide estimates during consultation.

service-page.question: Do you handle international projects?
service-page.answer: Absolutely! Though based in Namibia, we serve clients globally with our advanced digital collaboration tools and global creator network.

service-page.question: What is the onboarding process?
service-page.answer: After form submission, we schedule a 15-minute Discovery Call. If there's alignment, we issue a formal Protocol Proposal within 24 hours.

service-page.question: What is your refund policy?
service-page.answer: We offer project-specific refund policies outlined in our contract terms. Generally, refunds are considered based on project stage and deliverable completion.

service-page.question: Do you provide ongoing support after project completion?
service-page.answer: Yes, we offer maintenance and support packages to ensure continued success of your project. These can be customized to meet your specific needs.

service-page.question: How do you ensure brand consistency across different platforms?
service-page.answer: We develop comprehensive brand guidelines and style guides to maintain consistency across all touchpoints and platforms for your brand.

service-page.question: What technology stack do you use for web development?
service-page.answer: We work with modern technologies including React, Vue, Next.js, Node.js, and cloud platforms like AWS and Google Cloud, depending on project requirements.

service-page.question: How do you handle revisions and feedback?
service-page.answer: We include a specified number of revision rounds in our contracts. We encourage structured feedback to ensure efficient project iteration and client satisfaction.

service-page.question: Can you provide examples of past work?
service-page.answer: Yes, visit our Portfolio section to see diverse projects across various industries. We showcase our work in content production, digital management, events, and podcasting.
